principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss Typography with Cyberpunk Aesthetics
Content is King: Data is the art

usage_rules.headings: Use 'Unbounded' for all H1-H3. Tight tracking (-0.02em). Font weights: 300 (Light) or 700 (Bold).
usage_rules.body: Use 'Manrope' for UI text. High legibility.
usage_rules.numbers: Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all prices, wallet addresses, and transaction hashes.

dashboard.spacing: Compact but breathable (p-6). Bento grid style.

buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 font-bold tracking-wide shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,240,255,0.3)] transition-all hover:scale-105
buttons.secondary: rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-transparent hover:bg-white/10 text-white transition-all

cards.dashboard: rounded-2xl bg-card border border-border/50 hover:border-primary/30 transition-colors p-6
cards.marketing: rounded-3xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-md p-8

inputs.default: bg-white/5 border-white/10 focus:border-primary focus:ring-primary/20 rounded-xl h-12

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px for elegance. 2px for active states.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css immediately.
2. UPDATE TAILWIND: Replace the colors in tailwind.config.js with the HSL values provided in 'colors.tailwind_config'.
3. CREATE LAYOUTS: Build a 'DashboardLayout' (Sidebar + Topbar) and a 'MarketingLayout' (Navbar + Footer).
4. USE SHADCN: Customize shadcn components to match the 'Deep Cosmos' theme (remove rounded-md, use rounded-xl or full).
5. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to all interactive elements.
6. MOCK DATA: Create a robust mock data file for crypto prices and portfolio history since backend might not be ready.
7. CHARTS: Use Recharts with the custom theme colors (Primary for main line, Secondary for comparison).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
